170	    from agg_supplies_by_product as detail
   171	    left join jnr_add_locations as master  -- FLAG master_outer L1476: JNR_ADD_SUPPLIES is a Master Outer Join: it keeps every row from AGG_SUPPLIES_BY_PRODUCT (detail) and only the rows from JNR_ADD_LOCATIONS (master) that match; JNR_ADD_LOCATIONS rows with no match are dropped
   172	        on master.product_id = detail.product_id
   173	),
   174	
   175	-- EXP_ITEM_CALCULATIONS · Expression · L1486–1519
   176	exp_item_calculations as (
   177	    select
   178	        jnr_add_supplies.order_item_id,
   179	        jnr_add_supplies.order_id,
   180	        jnr_add_supplies.product_id,
   181	        jnr_add_supplies.customer_id,
   182	        jnr_add_supplies.location_id,
   183	        jnr_add_supplies.ordered_at_day,
   184	        jnr_add_supplies.product_name,
   185	        jnr_add_supplies.product_type,
   186	        jnr_add_supplies.product_price,
   187	        jnr_add_supplies.is_food_item,
   188	        jnr_add_supplies.is_drink_item,
   189	        case when (jnr_add_supplies.customer_name is null) then 'Unknown' else jnr_add_supplies.customer_name end as customer_name,
   190	        case when (jnr_add_supplies.location_name is null) then 'Unknown' else jnr_add_supplies.location_name end as location_name,
   191	        case when (jnr_add_supplies.region is null) then 'Unknown' else jnr_add_supplies.region end as region,
   192	        jnr_add_supplies.product_price as item_revenue,
   193	        /* v_SUPPLY_COST_CL L1511 */ (case when (jnr_add_supplies.supply_cost_per_product is null) then 0 else jnr_add_supplies.supply_cost_per_product end) as item_cogs,
   194	        jnr_add_supplies.product_price - /* v_SUPPLY_COST_CL L1511 */ (case when (jnr_add_supplies.supply_cost_per_product is null) then 0 else jnr_add_supplies.supply_cost_per_product end) as item_gross_profit,
   195	        /* v_MARGIN_CALC L1513 */ (case when jnr_add_supplies.product_price = 0 then 0 else (jnr_add_supplies.product_price - /* v_SUPPLY_COST_CL L1511 */ (case when (jnr_add_supplies.supply_cost_per_product is null) then 0 else jnr_add_supplies.supply_cost_per_product end)) / jnr_add_supplies.product_price end) as item_gross_margin_pct,
   196	        jnr_add_supplies.product_price * /* v_TAX_RATE_CL L1510 */ (case when (jnr_add_supplies.tax_rate is null) then 0 else jnr_add_supplies.tax_rate end) as item_tax_estimate,
   197	        jnr_add_supplies.product_price + (jnr_add_supplies.product_price * /* v_TAX_RATE_CL L1510 */ (case when (jnr_add_supplies.tax_rate is null) then 0 else jnr_add_supplies.tax_rate end)) as item_total_estimate,
   198	        /* v_HAS_PERISHABLE_CL L1512 */ (case when (jnr_add_supplies.has_perishable_supply is null) then 0 else jnr_add_supplies.has_perishable_supply end) as has_perishable_supply
   199	    from jnr_add_supplies
   200	),
   201	
   202	-- SRT_ORDER_ID · Sorter · L1520–1551 · dropped: row order means nothing in a table (decision Q12)
   203	-- SRT_BEFORE_AGG_PDP · Sorter · L2130–2149 · dropped: row order means nothing in a table (decision Q12)
   204	-- AGG_BY_PRODUCT_DAY · Aggregator · L2150–2171
   205	agg_by_product_day as (
   206	    select
   207	        exp_item_calculations.product_id,
   208	        exp_item_calculations.product_name,
   209	        exp_item_calculations.product_type,
   210	        exp_item_calculations.ordered_at_day,
   211	        count(exp_item_calculations.order_item_id) as units_sold,
   212	        sum(exp_item_calculations.item_revenue) as revenue,
   213	        sum(exp_item_calculations.item_cogs) as cogs,
   214	        sum(exp_item_calculations.item_gross_profit) as gross_profit,
   215	        max(exp_item_calculations.has_perishable_supply) as perishable_sales_flag
   216	    from exp_item_calculations
   217	    group by exp_item_calculations.product_id, exp_item_calculations.product_name, exp_item_calculations.product_type, exp_item_calculations.ordered_at_day
   218	),
   219	
   220	-- EXP_PRODUCT_METRICS · Expression · L2172–2184
   221	exp_product_metrics as (
   222	    select
   223	        agg_by_product_day.product_id,
   224	        agg_by_product_day.product_name,
   225	        agg_by_product_day.product_type,
   226	        agg_by_product_day.ordered_at_day,
   227	        agg_by_product_day.units_sold,
   228	        agg_by_product_day.revenue,
   229	        agg_by_product_day.cogs,
   230	        agg_by_product_day.gross_profit,
   231	        agg_by_product_day.perishable_sales_flag,
   232	        case when agg_by_product_day.revenue = 0 then 0 else agg_by_product_day.gross_profit / agg_by_product_day.revenue end as margin_pct
   233	    from agg_by_product_day
   234	)
   235	
   236	select
   237	    cast(exp_product_metrics.product_id as varchar) as product_id,
   238	    cast(exp_product_metrics.product_name as varchar) as product_name,
   239	    cast(exp_product_metrics.product_type as varchar) as product_type,
   240	    cast(exp_product_metrics.ordered_at_day as timestamp) as ordered_at_day,
   241	    cast(exp_product_metrics.units_sold as decimal(15,0)) as units_sold,
   242	    cast(exp_product_metrics.revenue as decimal(12,2)) as revenue,
   243	    cast(exp_product_metrics.cogs as decimal(12,2)) as cogs,
   244	    cast(exp_product_metrics.gross_profit as decimal(12,2)) as gross_profit,
   245	    cast(exp_product_metrics.perishable_sales_flag as decimal(10,4)) as margin_pct,  -- FLAG crossed L2542: EXP_PRODUCT_METRICS.PERISHABLE_SALES_FLAG goes into PRODUCT_DAILY_PERFORMANCE.MARGIN_PCT, as the connector says
   246	    cast(exp_product_metrics.margin_pct as decimal(1,0)) as perishable_sales_flag  -- FLAG crossed L2543: EXP_PRODUCT_METRICS.MARGIN_PCT goes into PRODUCT_DAILY_PERFORMANCE.PERISHABLE_SALES_FLAG, as the connector says; FLAG rounds L2543: MARGIN_PCT is computed as IIF(REVENUE=0,0,GROSS_PROFIT/REVENUE) (L2182), a double at run time because high precision is off, and is rounded to 0 decimal places by the target column PERISHABLE_SALES_FLAG decimal(1,0) (decision Q11)
   247	from exp_product_metrics

# pc2dbt: PowerCenter mapping XML to dbt

A converter from an Informatica PowerCenter mapping export to a dbt project, with tests.

This README is written in full in build step 4 (how to run, assumptions, what isn't handled, where the
output is likely wrong, the agent's mistakes, prompts, process and time). Until then it lists only the
unknowns found so far.

## Unknowns

Things the converter has to assume because Informatica's documentation doesn't settle them or we
couldn't confirm them. Each one has a test that pins the behaviour we chose, so a change shows up.

| Unknown | What the converter does | Pinned by |
|---|---|---|
| How an Aggregator groups rows whose group-by key is NULL. One Informatica guide (for a different product) says no group is created; a PowerCenter guide mentions "null groups". | SQL's rule: all NULL keys form one group. The jaffle-shop seed has no NULL keys, so the comparison is not affected. | `tests/test_convert_marts_mini.py::test_null_group_keys_form_one_group` |
| Whether `DATE_DIFF(date1, date2, 'DD')` returns fractions of a day. | Exact elapsed days with fractions (12 hours = 0.5). This XML truncates both dates first (L2300, L2318), so its results are whole days either way. | `tests/test_expressions.py::test_date_diff_in_days_keeps_fractions` |

index bb089a4..d3d74fb 100644
--- a/pc2dbt/expr.py
+++ b/pc2dbt/expr.py
@@ -83,6 +83,7 @@ class Parser:
         self.i = 0
         self.symbols = {k.upper(): v for k, v in symbols.items()}
         self.aggregates = aggregates
+        self.self_compares: list[str] = []  # comparisons with the same value on both sides
 
     def peek(self):
         return self.tokens[self.i]
@@ -108,6 +109,8 @@ class Parser:
                 return left
             self.take()
             right = self.expression(BINARY[op] + 1)
+            if op in COMPARISON and bare(left.sql) == bare(right.sql):
+                self.self_compares.append(bare(left.sql))
             left = binary(op, left, right)
 
     def unary(self) -> Expr:
@@ -168,6 +171,23 @@ class Parser:
         return Expr(f"{name.lower()}({arg.sql})", "decimal" if name == "COUNT" else arg.pc_type)
 
 
+def bare(sql: str) -> str:
+    """SQL without comments, spaces or wrapping brackets, to tell whether two sides are the same value."""
+    sql = re.sub(r"\s+", "", re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/", "", sql))
+    while sql.startswith("(") and sql.endswith(")") and depth_never_zero(sql[1:-1]):
+        sql = sql[1:-1]
+    return sql
+
+
+def depth_never_zero(inner: str) -> bool:
+    depth = 0
+    for ch in inner:
+        depth += {"(": 1, ")": -1}.get(ch, 0)
+        if depth < 0:
+            return False
+    return depth == 0
+
+
 def binary(op: str, a: Expr, b: Expr) -> Expr:
     if op in ("AND", "OR"):
         return Expr(f"({a.sql} {op.lower()} {b.sql})", "boolean")
@@ -221,13 +241,24 @@ def function(name: str, args: list[Expr]) -> Expr:
         return Expr(f"strptime({args[0].sql}, {strftime_format(args[1].sql)})", "date/time")
     if name == "TRUNC" and n == 1 and args[0].pc_type == "date/time":
         return Expr(f"date_trunc('day', {args[0].sql})", "date/time")
+    if name == "DATE_DIFF" and n == 3 and args[2].pc_type == "string":
+        # date1 - date2 in the unit asked for, with fractions (Informatica), not calendar boundaries.
+        if args[2].sql.upper() not in ("'D'", "'DD'", "'DDD'", "'DY'", "'DAY'"):
+            raise UnsupportedFunction(f"DATE_DIFF with format {args[2].sql}")
+        return Expr(f"((epoch({args[0].sql}) - epoch({args[1].sql})) / 86400)", "double")
     if name == "TRUNC" and n == 1 and args[0].pc_type in NUMERIC:

                  where exists (select 1 from raw.raw_items i where i.order_id = o.id))"""
SEED_CUSTOMERS = f"(select customer, count(*) as n, max(day) as last_day, sum(order_total) as spend from {SEED_ORDERS} group by 1)"

                   join raw.raw_products p on p.sku = i.sku
                   join (select sku, sum(cost / 100) as cost from raw.raw_supplies group by 1) s on s.sku = i.sku)"""

# (fact, query on our models, query on the raw seed)
FACTS = [

    ("Smallest recency in days (run_date 2025-12-31)",

def test_our_project_builds_with_dbt_on_duckdb(built):

    assert ours.returncode == 0, ours.log


def test_seed_facts(built):
    ours, _ = built
    con = duckdb.connect(str(ours.db), read_only=True)
    one = lambda sql: con.execute(sql).fetchone()[0]
    facts = []
    for fact, mine, seed in FACTS:
        got, want = one(mine), one(seed)
        facts.append({"fact": fact, "ours": str(got), "seed": str(want), "status": "match" if got == want else "differs"})
    RESULTS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (RESULTS / "enriched_facts.json").write_text(json.dumps(facts, indent=2) + "\n")
    assert [f for f in facts if f["status"] != "match"] == []


def test_every_difference_from_jaffle_shop_twins_is_explained(built):
    ours, reference = built
    results = harness.compare(ours.db, reference.db, harness.load_expected("enriched"))
    (RESULTS / "enriched.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + "\n")
    problems = [(t["table"], c["ours"] or c["reference"], c["status"])
                for t in results["tables"] for c in t["columns"] if c["status"] in ("unexplained", "stale")]
    problems += [(t["table"], "rows", t["rows"]["status"]) for t in results["tables"]
                 if t["rows"]["status"] not in ("matched", "explained")]
    assert problems == []

"""The real enriched marts mapping (m_FL_JS_MARTS_ENRICHED), run in DuckDB on hand-made staging rows.

The staging rows look exactly as step 1 writes them, swaps included: stg_orders' dollar columns hold cents,
stg_products.product_price holds cents. Every expected value is worked out by hand from the XML.

  orders  o1 c1 l1 2025-08-30  items i1 (JAF), i2 (BEV)   subtotal 700, tax 42,  total 742.00 (cents)
          o2 c1 l1 2025-08-31  item  i3 (JAF)             subtotal 1600, tax 160, total 1760.00
          o3 c2 l1 2025-08-31  item  i4 (JAF)             subtotal 1100, tax 66,  total 1166.00
          o4 c2 l1 2025-08-15  no items: dropped by JNR_ORDERS_ITEMS_AGG (Master Outer, L1591)
  customers c1 Ann, c2 Bob, c3 Cat (no orders: dropped by JNR_CUSTOMERS, L2243)
  locations l1 Philly AMER tax 0.06; l2 Tokyo (no orders: its extra rows are dropped before any table)
  supplies  JAF-001: 0.07 + 0.50 = 0.57, not perishable; BEV-001: 0.30, perishable

Per item: price 1100.00 (JAF) or 450.00 (BEV); cost 0.57 / 0.30; profit 1099.43 / 449.70;
margin 0.9995 / 0.9993; tax estimate price x 0.06 = 66.00 / 27.00.
Per order: o1 2 lines, revenue 1550.00, cost 0.87, profit 1549.13, margin 0.9994, tax rate 42/700 = 0.06.
Value band: ORDER_TOTAL >= 50 (L1740) compares cents with 50, so every order is HIGH.
Counter (L1706): one running number by customer, day, order: o1 1, o2 2, o3 3.
IS_FIRST_CUSTOMER (L2127) compares each value with itself, so it is 0 and UNIQUE_CUSTOMERS (L2004) is 0.
CUSTOMER_360: recency from $$RUN_DATE 2025-12-31 to 2025-08-31 = 122 days, R 1; F 2 (c1) / 1 (c2);
lifetime spend in cents >= 200, M 3; c1 123 AT_RISK, c2 113 STANDARD. Spend, pre-tax and tax land in each
other's columns (crossed at L2480-2482).
"""

from decimal import Decimal as D

import duckdb
import pytest

from pc2dbt.convert import convert_mapping
from pc2dbt.parse import parse_file
from tests.helpers import DEMO_XML, run_model

create table stg_orders (order_id varchar, customer_id varchar, location_id varchar, ordered_at_day timestamp,

"""Build docs/assets/results-data.js for the Results page.

One section per mapping. For each converted table: every box of the mapping as XML lines, next to
the SQL it became, plus the comparison with jaffle-shop from tests/reference/results/<section>.json.

Usage (from the repo root, with the project venv):
    .venv/bin/python tools/docs/build_results_data.py <xml> <out.js> <mapping>=<results.json>[+<facts.json>] [...]
"""
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))
from pc2dbt.convert import convert_mapping  # noqa: E402
from pc2dbt.parse import parse_file  # noqa: E402

xml_path, out_path = sys.argv[1:3]
pairs = [a.split("=", 1) for a in sys.argv[3:]]
lines = Path(xml_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
NOISE = re.compile(r'\s(DESCRIPTION|PICTURETEXT|OBJECTVERSION|VERSIONNUMBER|REUSABLE|BUSINESSNAME|FIELDNUMBER|FIELDPROPERTY|'
                   r'FIELDTYPE|HIDDEN|LENGTH|LEVEL|OCCURS|OFFSET|PHYSICALLENGTH|PHYSICALOFFSET|USAGE_FLAGS|'
                   r'SHIFTSENSITIVE|MAPPLETGROUP|SORTDIRECTION|KEYTYPE|NULLABLE|EXPRESSIONTYPE)\s*="[^"]*"')
SKIP = re.compile(r'<TABLEATTRIBUTE NAME ="(Tracing Level|Sorter Cache Size|Aggregator Data Cache Size|Aggregator Index Cache Size|Work Directory|Merge Only|Partitioning|'
                  r'Transformation Scope|Null Treated Low|Case Sensitive|Is Partitionable|Pre SQL|Post SQL|Sql Query|'

def excerpt(start: int, end: int) -> list:
    out = []
    for n in range(start, end + 1):
        text = lines[n - 1]
        if "VALUEPAIR" in text:
            raise SystemExit(f"refusing to copy credential line L{n}")
        if SKIP.search(text):

        out.append([n, NOISE.sub("", text.strip()).replace(" =", "=")])

"""Turn agent_log.md into docs/assets/log-data.js for the Process log page.

agent_log.md is the source. This script only reads it, checks it, and writes JSON.

Checks (the script stops on any failure):
  - every prompt matches the user's message in the saved conversation, word for word,
    after shared links are replaced with [link removed]
  - no URL the user shared appears in the log or the output
  - no token unique to the XML's credential line appears in the log or the output

Usage: python3 -I build_log_data.py <repo_root> <transcript.jsonl> <xml>
"""
import json
import re
import sys

repo, transcript, xml_path = sys.argv[1:4]
md_path = f"{repo}/agent_log.md"
out_path = f"{repo}/docs/assets/log-data.js"
md = open(md_path, encoding="utf-8").read()


def cells(row):
    return [c.strip() for c in row.strip().strip("|").split("|")]


def table(lines):
    rows = [l for l in lines if l.startswith("|")]
    return [cells(r) for r in rows[2:]]  # skip header + separator

"""The enriched marts' new parts on the hand-made fixture, run in DuckDB.

Variable ports are decided by port order (prompt 12): PowerCenter evaluates input ports, then variable
ports top to bottom, then output ports. A variable that reads only inputs or variables above it uses
this row only, so its SQL is pasted into the outputs that use it, with a /* name line */ comment.

raw_sales rows (hand-made):   sale_id shop  sold_at           price cost
                              s1      north 2025-06-01        10.00 4.00
                              s2      NULL  2025-06-29 18:30   5.00 NULL
                              s3      south 2025-05-31         0.00 1.00
                              s4      south 2025-01-01         NULL 1.00

v_COST_CL = cost or 0; v_MARGIN = (price - v_COST_CL) / price: s1 0.6, s2 1.0.
v_SAME_SHOP compares SHOP with v_PREV_SHOP, which already holds this row's SHOP: 0, or 1 when SHOP is
NULL (NULL = NULL is not true), so s1 0, s2 1.
v_AGE_DAYS = DATE_DIFF(TRUNC($$AS_OF), TRUNC(SOLD_AT), 'DD') with $$AS_OF = 06/30/2025: s1 29, s2 1.
FIL_PRICED keeps PRICE > 0: s3 (0) fails, s4 (NULL) is not true, so both are dropped.
"""
import duckdb
import pytest
from decimal import Decimal as D

from pc2dbt.convert import convert_mapping
from pc2dbt.parse import parse_file
from tests.helpers import MINI_ENRICHED_XML, line_of, run_model

SALES = """
create schema raw;
create table raw.raw_sales (sale_id varchar, shop varchar, sold_at timestamp, price decimal(8,2), cost decimal(8,2));
insert into raw.raw_sales values ('s1', 'north', '2025-06-01', 10.00, 4.00), ('s2', null, '2025-06-29 18:30', 5.00, null),
    ('s3', 'south', '2025-05-31', 0.00, 1.00), ('s4', 'south', '2025-01-01', null, 1.00);
"""


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def model():
    (m,) = convert_mapping(parse_file(MINI_ENRICHED_XML), "m_MINI_ENRICHED")
    return m


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def con():
    c = duckdb.connect()
    c.execute(SALES)
    return c


def test_row_local_variables_filter_and_run_date(model, con):
    assert run_model(con, model.sql) == [("s1", "north", D("0.6000"), D("0"), D("29")),
                                         ("s2", None, D("1.0000"), D("1"), D("1"))]


def test_a_mapping_parameter_is_a_dbt_var_with_the_xml_default(model, con):
    assert "{{ var('as_of', '2025-06-30') }}" in model.sql
    rows = run_model(con, model.sql, dbt_vars={"as_of": "2025-07-31"})
    assert [r[4] for r in rows] == [D("60"), D("32")]


def test_each_pasted_variable_keeps_its_name_and_line(model):
    for name in ("v_COST_CL", "v_MARGIN", "v_PREV_SHOP", "v_SAME_SHOP", "v_AGE_DAYS"):
        assert f"/* {name} L{line_of(MINI_ENRICHED_XML, f'NAME=\"{name}\"')} */" in model.sql


def test_comparing_a_value_with_itself_is_flagged(model):
    (flag,) = [f for f in model.flags if f.kind == "self_compare"]
    assert flag.line == line_of(MINI_ENRICHED_XML, 'NAME="v_SAME_SHOP"')
    assert "SHOP" in flag.message


def test_the_run_date_parameter_is_flagged(model):
    (flag,) = [f for f in model.flags if f.kind == "parameter"]
    assert flag.line == line_of(MINI_ENRICHED_XML, 'NAME="$$AS_OF"')

def convert_edited(tmp_path, old: str, new: str, count: int = 1):
    text = MINI_MARTS_XML.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert text.count(old) == count
    path = tmp_path / "edited.xml"
    path.write_text(text.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
    return convert_mapping(parse_file(path), "m_MINI_MARTS")


def test_aggregator_port_without_an_aggregate_fails_clearly(tmp_path):
    # A non-group-by port with no aggregate returns "the last row" in PowerCenter: not translated (Q18).
    with pytest.raises(UnsupportedElement, match="AGG_BY_STORE.STORE"):
        convert_edited(tmp_path, 'EXPRESSIONTYPE="GROUPBY" NAME="STORE"', 'EXPRESSIONTYPE="GENERAL" NAME="STORE"')


def test_any_other_row_by_row_pattern_fails_clearly(tmp_path):
    # Comparing before overwriting would be a real per-person counter: a different pattern (decision Q13).
    with pytest.raises(UnsupportedElement, match="EXP_VISIT_NUM"):
        convert_edited(tmp_path, 'EXPRESSION="PERSON" EXPRESSIONTYPE="GENERAL" NAME="v_PREV_PERSON"',
                       'EXPRESSION="VISIT_ID" EXPRESSIONTYPE="GENERAL" NAME="v_PREV_PERSON"')


def test_variable_ports_need_a_sorter_right_before_them(tmp_path):
    # Without a Sorter the row order is whatever the source sends, so the numbers are not reproducible.
    with pytest.raises(UnsupportedElement, match="EXP_VISIT_NUM"):
        convert_edited(tmp_path, 'FROMINSTANCE="SRT_VISITS" FROMINSTANCETYPE="Sorter"',
                       'FROMINSTANCE="SQ_T_VISITS" FROMINSTANCETYPE="Source Qualifier"', count=2)


def test_null_group_keys_form_one_group(models):
    # Unknown in PowerCenter: the docs found don't say how an Aggregator groups NULL keys (README, Unknowns).
    # We keep SQL's rule and pin it here: g7 and h8 have no store, so AGG_BY_STORE makes ONE group of 2 visits,
    # 3.00 in total. It matches no store, so the Master Outer Join keeps it with an empty STORE_ID and STORE_NAME.
    con = duckdb.connect()
    con.execute(VISITS)
    con.execute("insert into t_visits values ('g7', 'cat', null, '2025-01-06', 1.00), ('h8', 'cat', null, '2025-01-07', 2.00)")
    assert run_model(con, models["t_store_totals"].sql, order_by="total") == [
        (None, None, D("2"), D("2"), D("3.00"), dt.datetime(2025, 1, 6), dt.datetime(2025, 1, 7)),
        ("s1", "North", D("3"), D("2"), D("7.50"), dt.datetime(2025, 1, 1), dt.datetime(2025, 1, 5)),
        (None, None, D("3"), D("3"), D("15.00"), dt.datetime(2025, 1, 1), dt.datetime(2025, 1, 4))]
